items.summary: Initial source-linked four-layer guide, visual boundary map and draft-only layer selector.
Expanded the first guide into a research library with a comparison and separate dated dossiers for all four projects.
Added the n8n license-boundary audit, dossier and Activepieces CE comparison; n8n is labelled source-available/fair-code rather than OSI-style open source.

Added the Loopmark replacement decision, narrowed its public label to exploratory local drafting CLI, recorded evidence gaps and a draft-only test, and added a dated library entry with List, Table, and Calendar views.
Added a controlled-pilot operations guide for Mautic and Activepieces CE, a static operating-boundary comparison, and one dated Research library record in List, Table, and Calendar views.

Added a permanent Marketing Agent OS audit covering upstream provenance limits, installer boundaries, host-owned controls, and a fictional-data local evaluation boundary; added it once to Research library List, Table, and Calendar views and updated the dossier.
Added the Mautic Community 7.2.1 campaign-operation boundary audit, updated the Mautic dossier, and added one dated Research library record in List, Table, and Calendar views.
Added a 0.92.0-anchored Activepieces CE document audit, updated its dossier and earlier pilot retention note, and added one dated Research library record in List, Table, and Calendar views.
Added a documentation-only cross-layer handoff and approval synthesis, a responsibility diagram, and exactly one dated Research library entry in List, Table and Calendar views.

Added a source-linked small-list newsletter decision audit, a decision-path diagram, and one dated Research library record in List, Table and Calendar views. Keila remains a private-evaluation candidate; Listmonk welcome trigger is unestablished; the vetted four-layer shortlist is unchanged.

Added the Keila v0.30.3 tagged-source and recovery-gate audit as one permanent Research library record in List, Table and Calendar views; updated small-list cross-links and metadata. K1 partly advanced but open; K3 and X1 open; no shortlist addition or send clearance.

Added a v6.2.0 tagged-code DOI-to-welcome audit and one Research collection record in List, Table and Calendar views. Inspected confirmation paths do not send a distinct welcome; /api/tx is not a consent or duplicate gate. No runtime test or shortlist addition.

Added a permanent Listmonk v6.2.0 private-test gate and one dated Research library record in List, Table and Calendar. No runtime test ran: artifact, isolated app/database, sink-only mail and teardown were unavailable; no send clearance or shortlist addition.

Added a permanent phpList v3.6.16 one-email welcome audit and one Research library record in List, Table and Calendar views. Tagged confirmation handler shows an immediate system message path; signup/editor and runtime/send outcomes remain unverified. Conditional research entry only, no shortlist addition.

Added a task-first small-list welcome decision contract, a handoff-ledger diagram and one permanent Research record in List, Table and Calendar. Updated the home decision path and dated metadata. Source synthesis only; no send clearance or shortlist addition.

Added a Ghost v6.63.0 source-only welcome audit as one permanent Research record in List, Table and Calendar. Existing publication-site route is conditional; delayed sequence beta is separate. No send clearance or shortlist addition.

Added a permanent Marketing Agent OS one-skill install-test gate report and one dated Research library entry in List, Table and Calendar; updated the dossier and safe-first-test guidance. Pinned checkout and network isolation unavailable; no installer execution, file effects or recommendation change.

Added a permanent Postiz v2.25.0 source-only sign-off audit and one dated Research record in List, Table and Calendar. Preview comments are not an enforced approval gate; no-channel draft unestablished; no live/provider/security test or shortlist addition.

Added a permanent Umami v3.4.0 tagged-newsletter UTM-to-signup measurement audit and one Research record in List, Table and Calendar. Post-click counts are distinct from delivery, verified accounts and causal ROI; no runtime test or shortlist addition.
